rfp.subject: Request for proposal: team retreat, 14 guests, 2 nights from 2027-03-10
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a team retreat and would like a proposal for:
- Dates: arrival 2027-03-10, departure 2027-03-12 (2 nights). 2027-03-17 is an alternative arrival date.
- Guests: 14
- Room nights: 28 (14 single-occupancy rooms for 2 nights)
- Meeting space: one main meeting room for all 3 days. No breakout rooms are needed.
- Dietary needs: none reported. Please tell us which options you offer.
- Accessibility: no wheelchair users.
- Budget: up to EUR 9,000 all in.

Please include a full price breakdown. Please reply by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
